title: POST /join success response body, version 1
description: The seat the Spine assigned. A repeat of a joinRequestId answers with the same values.

tableId.description: The table's id, which is also its URL slug.

seatId.description: The id of the seat just assigned; the envelope initiator's seatId on events from this seat.

seatNumber.description: Which of the table's 1-4 positions the seat occupies.

tableUrl.description: Absolute URL of the Tabletop page for this table, with ?seat=<seatId> naming the seat just assigned.
